name: @borjie/learning-signal-emitter
description: Learning signal emitter (LP-17). One (action, outcome) → reward-scored → per-tier isolation-gated → fanned out to injected sinks (belief / mastery / pattern / reflexion / preference). Pure reward model + isolation gate; never writes a belief directly (routes through the belief sink). Ported from LITFIN learning/signal-emitter + reward-model + per-tier-isolation.
